Workspace.title: Workspace
Workspace.description: Dealership or inspection center workspace containing authorized members and inspection records

name.description: Display name of the inspection center or dealership

code.description: Short invitation or tracking code for the workspace

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner

ownerEmail.description: Email address of the workspace owner

members.description: Map of user UID to workspace member role and profile info

Inspection.title: Inspection
Inspection.description: Comprehensive vehicle inspection record belonging to a workspace

vehicle.description: Vehicle details, make, model, year, plate, mileage

items.description: List of checklist items with status, notes, and weights

inspectorName.description: Name of inspector who performed inspection

revision.description: Revision number for optimistic concurrency and conflict detection

lastModifiedBy.description: UID of last user who modified record

isDeleted.description: Soft deletion tombstone marker for multi-device sync

PhotoEvidenceMeta.title: PhotoEvidenceMeta
PhotoEvidenceMeta.description: Metadata for photo evidence attached to a defective inspection item

storagePath.description: Cloud Storage path for secure authenticated retrieval

/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: Workspace records for dealerships and inspection centers

/workspaces/{workspaceId}/inspections/{i.description: Photo evidence metadata attached to an inspection
